meta.title: 摸脚踝就能出片？！超适合普通人的拍照动作
meta.title_en: Touch Your Ankle and Nail the Shot?! An Easy Pose for Everyone

scenes.context: 摸脚踝出片的起始姿势：侧身、大腿平行地面、绷脚背。这个动作普通人很容易上手。语域：拍照教学，姿势讲解。
sentences: 起始姿势：侧身，大腿平行地面。
Start pose: sideways, thigh parallel to the ground.
parallel to the ground（平行地面）
绷脚背，线条更好看。
Point the foot for a cleaner line.
point the foot（绷脚背）
这是超适合普通人的动作。
It's a pose anyone can pull off.
anyone can pull off（超适合普通人）
paraphrase: 侧身 → sideways / turned to the side
绷脚背 → point the foot / flexed toes
scenes.speak: Start pose: sideways, thigh parallel to the ground. Point the foot for a cleaner line. It's a pose anyone can pull off.

scenes.context: 以胯为轴折叠：上半身不驼背，折叠点在胯。摸脚踝时假装提鞋、肩膀保持直线、头微歪，更自然。语域：拍照教学，姿势讲解。
sentences: 以胯为轴折叠，上半身不驼背。
Fold at the hips — keep the upper body straight.
fold at the hips（以胯为轴）
摸脚踝，假装在提鞋。
Touch the ankle as if adjusting your shoe.
adjusting your shoe（提鞋）
肩膀直线，头微歪。
Shoulders in a line, head slightly tilted.
head slightly tilted（头微歪）
paraphrase: 折叠点 → the fold point / the hinge
提鞋 → adjusting your shoe / faking a tie
scenes.speak: Fold at the hips — keep the upper body straight. Touch the ankle as if adjusting your shoe. Shoulders in a line, head slightly tilted.

scenes.context: 关键技巧：做成动态过程，在动作中抓拍。抬膝关键：膝盖必须越过另一条腿，不能平行。语域：拍照教学，技巧讲解。
sentences: 做成动态过程，在动作中抓拍。
Make it a dynamic process — shoot mid-motion.
shoot mid-motion（动作中抓拍）
抬膝时，膝盖要越过另一条腿。
When lifting the knee, cross past the other leg.
cross past the other leg（越过另一条腿）
不能平行，平行就死板。
Not parallel — parallel looks stiff.
looks stiff（死板）
paraphrase: 动态过程 → a dynamic process / keep it moving
越过 → cross past / pass over
scenes.speak: Make it a dynamic process — shoot mid-motion. When lifting the knee, cross past the other leg. Not parallel — parallel looks stiff.

scenes.context: 收尾细节：绷脚尖、小腿平行地面、胯上顶、手自由发挥。整套动作下来非常出片。语域：拍照教学，收尾。
sentences: 收尾：绷脚尖，小腿平行地面。
Closing: pointed toes, calves parallel to the ground.
pointed toes（绷脚尖）
胯上顶，提升整体姿态。
Hips lifted to elevate the whole pose.
elevate the pose（提升姿态）
手自由发挥，更松弛。
Hands ad-lib for a relaxed feel.
ad-lib（自由发挥）
paraphrase: 胯上顶 → hips lifted / push the hips up
自由发挥 → ad-lib / do whatever feels natural
scenes.speak: Closing: pointed toes, calves parallel to the ground. Hips lifted to elevate the whole pose. Hands ad-lib for a relaxed feel.

practice: Start pose: sideways, thigh parallel to the ground.
Fold at the hips — keep the upper body straight.
Make it a dynamic process — shoot mid-motion.
Closing: pointed toes, calves parallel to the ground.
pitfalls: Start pose: sideways, thigh parallel to the ground.
Fold at the hips — keep the upper body straight.
「以胯为轴」用 fold at the hips，不是 bend back。
The knee must cross past the other leg.
「膝盖越过」用 cross past，不能平行。
Hands ad-lib for a relaxed feel.
shifts: 用 pull off（驾驭动作）、shoot mid-motion（动作中拍）、ad-lib（自由发挥）
用 fold at the hips（以胯为轴）、cross past（越过）、hips lifted（胯上顶）
用 a cleaner line（线条更干净）、elevate the pose（提升姿态）、relaxed feel（松弛感）
